reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence construction and weekend adjustment helpers, but the range handler independently implements nonworking-day detection and daily skipping.

duplication.why: Daily nonworking-day policy is duplicated between getNextDate and getDatesInRange, and getNextDate repeats its filtering block for forward and reverse searches.

placement.why: Handler registration and configuration plumbing fit existing layers, but schedule policy in getDatesInRange belongs alongside the shared scheduling definitions.

scope.why: All edits address the requested scheduling rules, range endpoint, holiday configuration, or their tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate separate occurrence policies across next-date calculation, calendar ranges, upcoming dates, and budget iteration.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange independently detects nonworking days and selects daily skipping rather than sharing the policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes getNextDate's daily nonworking-day filtering into flatMap dispatch and reconstructs the shared nonworking-day predicate with isWeekend and holidays.includes.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds two daily-only filtering branches and a non-daily adjustment guard; getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates, and both budget adjustment sites apply occurrence policy outside that shared next-date definition.
